content.comment_body: Hi, I'm new to the forum. My [product_name] is running, and I've successfully loaded the program. I'm currently using [article_no] and would like to add two additional input modules with [article_no]. The LED indicator is red. Are these modules compatible? Do I need to change any settings to activate the port? Thanks in advance. Kind regards, [user_name]

No, they are incompatible. Your [product_name] is the current [product_name] with [version_no]. It's a [article_no] model from the 4th Generation. Expansion modules with an [article_no] ending in 0BA0 or 0BA1 do not work with [article_no] models. Only modules with [article_no] ending in 0BA2 are supported by [article_no] models.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered a compatibility issue while trying to add older input modules to their latest [product_name] base module. The red LED light indicated a hardware mismatch. It was clarified that only expansion modules with [article_no] ending in 0BA2 are compatible with the current [version_no] generation, while those with 0BA0 or 0BA1 are not supported.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected to easily integrate older input modules into their current [product_name] base module without encountering compatibility or activation problems.
